source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The app pane cannot be restored directly because application selection belongs to the start flow. Current showTab redirects app to start with reset=true when there is no step history. This fixes the regression after the external-pane change. The browser test opens about:import#app, waits for #start and checks the start pane. Tests use a same-hash tick fallback because assigning the existing hash produces no hashchange event. The current file is registered under mailnews/import/test/browser/browser.toml; the historical mail/test/browser/import/browser.ini path is retired.
title: Restore the import start flow when the saved profile pane lacks its prerequisite
